messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}
Thanks for helping me with
my clothing obsession.
{07 15 00}Now that I'm wearing some
hot clothes, I should
probably work on my mood.
{07 00 00}People won't think I'm cool
if I keep yelling at 'em,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}
Aitäh, et aitasid mind mu
riidekinnisideega.
{07 15 00}Nüüd, kui mul on kuumad
riided, peaksin vist
tegelema oma tujuga.
{07 00 00}Inimesed ei pea mind
lahedaks, kui ma neid
karjun, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} you've actually
been kinda helpful lately.

{07 00 00}Thanks to you,{01 00 00 0f 00} I'm less
embarrassed about eating
out alone, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}But, the thing is{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Even I
don't want to be alone all
the time.
{07 1c 00}I think I'm done with 
the whole fashion thing for
a while, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}I'm going to take up some
hobby that's less trendy,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}But thanks for all your
help, {04 1f 00}.
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
